title: 第七章 惹了不该惹的人第八章 赶紧来网球场上
content_zh:
没错，陆原就是雪诺。
想到今天在东篱小酒吧，被何敏室友们看不起的事，想到李梦瑶和自己分手的事。
陆原突然觉得，自己的价值观会不会错了？
朴实真诚是好事，但是这个世界，已经是金钱的世界了。
如果真是这样，那就用金钱来说话吧。
当看到李宏飞在直播间里装逼，尤其是连续嘲弄打压张辉和宋纯，陆原冷笑一声，直接充了二十万到账号里。
这点钱对于陆原来说，连零头的零头都算不上的。
当看到尹伊对雪诺一口一个哥哥，目光充满一种女性天然的挑逗的时候，陆原心里竟然泛出了一丝快感。
靠，莫非我骨子里其实还是一个嚣张跋扈的富二代？
好吧，咱们慢慢来。
第二天，快到中午的时候。
陈锋回来了。
“老陈，终于回来了啊，腿都软了吧？哈哈。”宋纯挤了挤眼睛。
“有女朋友就是好啊。”张辉也是羡慕的说道。
昨天晚上，陈锋并没有回寝室，东篱小酒吧聚了之后，他就和何敏出去玩了，一夜没回来，干嘛了不用说也很清楚。
“兄弟们，不好了。”陈锋却开口说道。
“啊，咋地了？你和何敏分手了？”张辉口无遮拦的说道。
“不是吧，何敏人挺好的啊。”宋纯显得很郁闷，他知道一旦陈锋和何敏分手，那寝室联谊就自动取消了，自己也没机会和何敏那些室友们一起聚了。
虽然宋纯也知道泡上何敏那些闺蜜是不可能的，但是平时能出来一起聚一聚，吃吃饭，出来玩一玩，已经很满足了。
“靠，没有。”

陈锋揉了揉鼻子，“秦九儿出事了。”
“她出事了？”张辉一愣，随即两手一拍，“好！太好了！”
“就是，恶人有恶报啊，没想到报应来的真快！昨天怎么对老陆的，呵呵。”宋纯也乐了，拍手称好。
“出什么事了？”
陆原问道。
那个秦九儿虽然那对自己看不起，昨天还离席拂袖而走，不过想一想，秦九儿是何敏的好朋友，何敏和陈锋又是男女朋友，这层关系在这里呢。
“唉，你们知道，昨天秦九儿走的时候，不是遇到了一个男生吗？”陈锋说道。
“没错，那男生好像当时想给她敬酒来着的。”
“可能是她朋友吧，没听清楚她说什么。”
“不过秦九儿不是打了那男生一巴掌吗，啧啧，脾气果然够火爆的。看来那男生也是个吊丝，惹了秦九儿了。”
宋纯和张辉两人想了想昨天晚上的事情，说道。
“你们都错了，那个男生并不是秦九儿认识的，他是来搭讪秦九儿的。”陈锋说道，“而且，那男生更不是吊丝，而是一个很厉害的富二代，是圣堂集团的太子爷，叫于天齐。他老爸不是别人，就是圣堂集团的老总于大勇。”
什么？！
content_en:
Yes, Lu Yuan is Snow.
He thought about being looked down upon by He Min's roommates at Dongli Bar today, and about Li Mengyao breaking up with him.
Lu Yuan suddenly felt that his values ​​​​could be wrong?
Being simple and sincere is a good thing, but this world is already a world of money.
If that's the case, let money speak for itself.
When he saw Li Hongfei acting cool in the live broadcast room, especially his continuous mockery and suppression of Zhang Hui and Song Chun, Lu Yuan sneered and directly recharged 200,000 yuan into his account.
For Lu Yuan, this amount of money is not even a fraction.
When he saw Yin Yi talking to Xu Nuo like a brother, his eyes filled with a natural female provocation, Lu Yuan actually felt a sense of pleasure in his heart.
Damn it, could it be that I am still an arrogant and domineering rich second generation at heart?
Okay, let's take our time.
The next day, it was almost noon.
Chen Feng is back.
"Old Chen, you're finally back. Are your legs weak? Haha." Song Chun winked.
"It's good to have a girlfriend." Zhang Hui also said enviously.
Last night, Chen Feng did not return to his dormitory. After the gathering at Dongli Bar, he went out to play with He Min and did not come back all night. It was clear why he did it.
"Brothers, it's not good." Chen Feng said.
"Ah, what happened? You and He Min broke up?" Zhang Hui said without hesitation.
"No, He Min is a nice person." Song Chun looked very depressed. He knew that once Chen Feng and He Min broke up, the dormitory party would be automatically cancelled, and he would not have the chance to get together with He Min's roommates.
Although Song Chun also knew that it was impossible to pick up He Min's best friends, she was very satisfied to be able to get together, eat and play together.
"Fuck, no."
Chen Feng rubbed his nose and said, "Something happened to Qin Jiu'er."
"Something happened to her?" Zhang Hui was stunned, then clapped his hands, "Okay! Great!"
"That's right, evil people will be punished. I didn't expect retribution to come so quickly! What did you do to Lao Lu yesterday? Haha." Song Chun was also happy and clapped her hands.
"What happened?"
Lu Yuan asked.
Although Qin Jiu'er looked down on him and walked away from the table yesterday, but think about it, Qin Jiu'er is He Min's good friend, and He Min and Chen Feng are boyfriend and girlfriend. This relationship is here.
"Well, you know, didn't Qin Jiuer meet a boy when he left yesterday?" Chen Feng said.
"Yes, that boy seemed to want to toast her."
"Maybe it's her friend. I didn't hear what she said clearly."
"But didn't Qin Jiu'er slap that boy? Tsk tsk, he's really hot-tempered. It seems that boy is also a loser and offended Qin Jiu'er."
Song Chun and Zhang Hui thought about what happened last night and said.
"You are all wrong. That boy is not Qin Jiu'er's acquaintance. He is here to chat with Qin Jiu'er." Chen Feng said, "Moreover, that boy is not Diaosi, but a very powerful second-generation rich man. He is the crown prince of Shengtang Group, named Yu Tianqi. His father is none other than Yu Dayong, the boss of Shengtang Group."
What? !
